scope: Four named profiler requests on one RTX 5080 / 617.42 configuration. Software masks and request responses; no measured physical gating.

static_findings.scope: Offline static evidence for one Windows 617.42 binary; no general compatibility or observed hardware result implied

callback.leaf: 0x84dae0 implements feature5 and7; feature19 takes unsupported path 0x56 when reached; empty filtered iteration can return success
callback.concurrency: Generic counted manager invokes callback at aggregate zero-to-nonzero and final release; successful requests can overlap without new physical or bitmap transition
callback.feature2: jump case 0x42b90e returns zero without feature operation
callback.features_5_7_19: jump case 0x42b43c builds engine bitset, filters through supported/resolved engine predicates, calls 0x84dae0 for each

elcg.request: 0x84dd8d ->0x755830 ->0x754910 sets reason bit2 at object+0x290+0x24*engine index and increments word counter +0x28c
elcg.qualifier: A801 type10 routes GPU+0x2550 then +0x12d8 to 0x7558e0. Support and no-disable-reason predicate, not ownership or measured residency. Attr0x802 per-engine equivalent lacks apparent support/index validation.
elcg.readback: A801 type10 attr1 returns supported engine bitmap; attr0x801 returns bitmap of supported engines whose reason mask is zero; both input u32 at item+0xc selects 32-bit chunk 0 or 1
elcg.release: 0x755870 ->0x754a10 decrements counter and clears bit2 when zero

static_findings.limit: 0x34fe00 is policy selector rather than ownership/effective-state readback. Other RM users can interfere; no source-qualified complete engine coverage.

limits: ELCG bitmap change is a partial independent witness; supported engine bits do not establish complete profiler group membership or ownership.
Other clients can hide a new transition; zero-eligible/no-transition requests cannot qualify Hold.
BLCG is unverified, not proven inert. ELCG and LPWR getters are not BLCG status.
SLCG and idle-slowdown successful responses do not establish effective changes. Static paths are configuration-specific evidence, not universal compatibility gates.
No registry write, workload, physical measurement, driver restart or Windows reboot. No persistence or automatic replay was added.

blcg_followup.scope: Offline inspected-driver trace only; no new hardware calls or product feature
blcg_followup.receiver: Selected graphics object from GPU+2268 array; BLCG dispatch calls its +1030 method. HAL initializer assigns RVA381810, A31410 or A3F8C0. Active target not observed.
blcg_followup.reason_state: A3F8C0 conditionally reaches 73DBE0: per-entry record at group+DD8+280h*index, reason bitmap +4 and reason-zero count +C. Hardware programming uses table-supplied offsets and values.
blcg_followup.getter_limit: Adjacent +1038 methods perform actions or initialization. A801 type10 reads a separate ELCG reason state; delegated attrs803/804/809 have no qualified relationship to this BLCG state. No external BLCG getter established.
